meaning.en: A place with a hidden, enchanting world of its own.
meaning.zh: 另有一番境界，形容风景或环境引人入胜。

examples.zh: 小巷深处别有洞天，是一家安静的茶馆。
examples.en: Deep in the alley lay a hidden world: a quiet tea house.

examples.zh: 穿过石门，里面别有洞天。
examples.en: Through the stone gate was a whole other world.

usage.en: Predicate; often 里面/其中别有洞天.

meaning.en: Changing in many different ways, hard to predict.
meaning.zh: 变化很多，难以捉摸。

examples.zh: 这里的天气变化多端。
examples.en: The weather here is ever-changing.

examples.zh: 市场形势变化多端，要随时调整。
examples.en: The market is full of shifts, so adjust as you go.

literal: Hegemon-King · bids farewell to · Concubine Yu
natural: Hegemon-King bids farewell to his concubine

meaning.en: The famous scene in which Xiang Yu parted from his concubine Yu Ji before his final defeat; a symbol of tragic parting.
meaning.zh: 楚汉相争中，项羽兵败垓下，与虞姬诀别，常用来指悲壮的离别。

examples.zh: 京剧《霸王别姬》是经典曲目。
examples.en: The Peking opera Farewell My Concubine is a classic.

examples.zh: 他们的告别像霸王别姬一样悲壮。
examples.en: Their parting was as tragic as the Hegemon-King's farewell.

meaning.en: Feeling dizzy as if the sky and earth are spinning; also, great upheaval.
meaning.zh: 天地都在旋转，形容头晕目眩，也比喻形势发生巨大变化。

examples.zh: 他一起身就觉得天旋地转。
examples.en: As soon as he stood up, the world began to spin.

examples.zh: 这个消息让她天旋地转。
examples.en: The news left her reeling.

meaning.en: So extraordinary as to shock society and conventional opinion.
meaning.zh: 言行或事物与众不同，使世人震惊。

examples.zh: 她的设计惊世骇俗，引来争议。
examples.en: Her design was shockingly daring and caused controversy.

examples.zh: 这种言论在当时可谓惊世骇俗。
examples.en: Such talk was truly shocking at the time.

meaning.en: A winding path leading to a quiet, secluded spot.
meaning.zh: 弯曲的小路通向幽静的地方。

equivalents: a winding path to a quiet spot

examples.zh: 园中曲径通幽，别有一番趣味。
examples.en: In the garden a winding path leads to quiet corners, with its own charm.

examples.zh: 沿着曲径通幽的小路走去，便是古寺。
examples.en: Follow the winding path into the quiet and you reach the old temple.

story.en: Tang poet Chang Jian: 'A winding path leads to a secluded place; the meditation hall is deep among flowers and trees' (曲径通幽处，禅房花木深).
story.zh: 常建《题破山寺后禅院》：“曲径通幽处，禅房花木深。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于写景。

meaning.en: To take up a new profession or field midway through life, without early training.
meaning.zh: 中途改行，从事自己原先不熟悉的行业。

examples.zh: 他是半路出家的程序员，原来学的是历史。
examples.en: He's a self-taught programmer who originally studied history.

examples.zh: 我是半路出家，还有很多要学。
examples.en: I came to this late and still have a lot to learn.

meaning.en: The countless ordinary people of the world.
meaning.zh: 佛教指一切有生命的东西，现多指许许多多的普通人。

examples.zh: 我们都只是芸芸众生中的一员。
examples.en: We are each just one among the multitudes.

examples.zh: 他关注芸芸众生的生活。
examples.en: He is concerned with the lives of ordinary people.

literal: again and again · weigh · push and knock

meaning.en: To think over wording or a plan again and again.
meaning.zh: 多次斟酌，仔细琢磨。

examples.zh: 这篇稿子他反复推敲了好几遍。
examples.en: He polished the draft several times over.

examples.zh: 方案要反复推敲后才能定稿。
examples.en: The plan must be examined repeatedly before it is finalised.

usage.en: Predicate; 推敲 recalls the poet Jia Dao's word choice.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“推敲”典出贾岛。

meaning.en: To advance step by step to a high level of skill or understanding.
meaning.zh: 由厅堂进入内室，比喻学问或技艺逐步达到高深的境界。

equivalents: get to the heart of a subject

examples.zh: 经过多年苦练，他的书法终于登堂入室。
examples.en: After years of practice his calligraphy reached true mastery.

examples.zh: 学围棋要先入门，再慢慢登堂入室。
examples.en: In Go, you first learn the basics, then gradually reach real depth.

story.en: Confucius on Zilu: he has 'ascended the hall' but has not yet 'entered the inner room' (由也升堂矣，未入于室也).
story.zh: 《论语》：“由也升堂矣，未入于室也。”

meaning.en: Level, open land where a horse can gallop freely.
meaning.zh: 一匹马可以纵情奔驰的平坦广阔的原野。

examples.zh: 东北平原一马平川，一眼望不到边。
examples.en: The northeastern plain is vast and flat to the horizon.

examples.zh: 出了山口，前面是一马平川。
examples.en: Out of the pass lay an open plain.

usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，形容地形。

meaning.en: To walk unsteadily, swaying and stumbling.
meaning.zh: 走路不稳，摇摇晃晃的样子。

examples.zh: 他喝醉了，踉踉跄跄地走回家。
examples.en: He was drunk and staggered home.

examples.zh: 伤员踉踉跄跄地走出战壕。
examples.en: The wounded man stumbled out of the trench.

meaning.en: To survive a terrible disaster, usually followed by good fortune.
meaning.zh: 经历大灾难而没有死去。

examples.zh: 他大难不死，必有后福。
examples.en: He survived the disaster; good fortune will surely follow.

examples.zh: 地震中她大难不死，现在成了志愿者。
examples.en: She survived the earthquake and now works as a volunteer.

usage.en: Usually 大难不死，必有后福.
usage.zh: 常说“大难不死，必有后福”。

meaning.en: A small investment that brings a huge profit.
meaning.zh: 本钱小，利润极大。

equivalents: a huge return on a small outlay

examples.zh: 他以为开店是一本万利的买卖。
examples.en: He thought opening a shop would be a goldmine.

examples.zh: 天下哪有一本万利的好事？
examples.en: Where on earth is there a deal with such returns?

meaning.en: A place of exceptional beauty and comfort, a paradise on earth.
meaning.zh: 人世间的天堂，形容景色优美、生活美好的地方。

examples.zh: 人们称杭州为人间天堂。
examples.en: Hangzhou is called paradise on earth.

examples.zh: 这座小岛简直是人间天堂。
examples.en: The little island is paradise on earth.

meaning.en: Full of grasping ambition.
meaning.zh: 形容怀有强烈的权势欲望。

examples.zh: 这个野心勃勃的年轻人想取而代之。
examples.en: The power-hungry young man wanted to take over.

examples.zh: 他野心勃勃，一心想当总经理。
examples.en: He's fiercely ambitious and set on becoming general manager.

meaning.en: In high spirits and eager to compete or fight.
meaning.zh: 斗争的意志旺盛。

examples.zh: 球员们斗志昂扬，准备迎接决赛。
examples.en: The players, full of fighting spirit, prepared for the final.

examples.zh: 大家斗志昂扬地投入工作。
examples.en: Everyone threw themselves into work with high morale.

natural: abuse public office for private gain

meaning.en: To use public resources or authority to benefit oneself.
meaning.zh: 借公家的名义或利用公家的东西谋取私利。

equivalents: abuse one's position for private gain
use public means for private ends

examples.zh: 他利用职权假公济私，最终被查处。
examples.en: He abused his post for private gain and was eventually investigated.

examples.zh: 用公车办私事就是假公济私。
examples.en: Using the official car for private errands is exploiting public resources.

meaning.en: Leaving endless trouble for later.
meaning.zh: 以后的祸患没有穷尽。

examples.zh: 现在不处理，将来后患无穷。
examples.en: Leave it alone now and you'll face endless trouble later.

examples.zh: 放任污染，后患无穷。
examples.en: Letting pollution go unchecked has dire long-term consequences.

meaning.en: To come and go alone, preferring one's own company or acting independently.
meaning.zh: 一个人来去，不与人往来，也指行动不受约束。

examples.zh: 他性格孤僻，总是独来独往。
examples.en: He's withdrawn and always keeps to himself.

examples.zh: 她喜欢独来独往，不爱参加聚会。
examples.en: She likes to go it alone and avoids parties.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or slightly negative.

meaning.en: Two things must both be kept up; neither may be neglected.
meaning.zh: 两方面都要重视，不能只顾一方而忽视另一方。

examples.zh: 学习和锻炼不可偏废。
examples.en: Study and exercise must both be kept up.

examples.zh: 理论与实践，二者不可偏废。
examples.en: Theory and practice: neither may be neglected.

usage.en: Predicate; often after 二者/两者.

meaning.en: Refined, high-brow art that only a few can appreciate.
meaning.zh: 古代高雅的歌曲，比喻高深、不通俗的文艺作品。

examples.zh: 这种音乐属阳春白雪，听众不多。
examples.en: This music is highbrow and has a small audience.

examples.zh: 他的作品既有阳春白雪，也有下里巴人。
examples.en: His works range from the highbrow to the popular.

story.en: Song Yu tells the king that when the highbrow songs 'Yangchun' and 'Baixue' were sung, only a few dozen people in the capital could join in.
story.zh: 宋玉《对楚王问》：“其为《阳春》《白雪》，国中属而和者，不过数十人。”

usage.en: Often paired with 下里巴人.

meaning.en: To draw on many sources and quotations to support an argument.
meaning.zh: 广泛地引用资料来论证。

examples.zh: 教授讲课旁征博引，学生们听得入迷。
examples.en: The professor lectured with wide-ranging references and the students were rapt.

examples.zh: 这篇论文旁征博引，论据充分。
examples.en: The paper cites widely and its arguments are well backed.

pinyin: jiǔ niú èr hǔ zhī lì

meaning.en: Enormous effort, as much as nine oxen and two tigers might muster.
meaning.zh: 形容很大的力气或极大的努力。

examples.zh: 我费了九牛二虎之力才把沙发搬上楼。
examples.en: It took a herculean effort to carry the sofa upstairs.

examples.zh: 他花了九牛二虎之力才说服老板。
examples.en: He needed enormous effort to persuade the boss.

usage.en: Object; often 费/花了九牛二虎之力.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“费了九牛二虎之力”。

meaning.en: About a year, or half a year: a vague, fairly short period.
meaning.zh: 一年或半年，泛指不太长的时间。

examples.zh: 这个项目一年半载完成不了。
examples.en: The project can't be finished in a year or so.

examples.zh: 他出国一年半载就会回来。
examples.en: He'll be back after a year or so abroad.

usage.en: Time phrase; often with 不用/不到.
